name: Cover: editorial
description: A magazine-page cover: thin rules top and bottom, the kicker top left, the subtitle set like a pull quote in a narrow column top right, the title anchored at the lower-left third with blank space above. A centred title slide would lose the rhythm of seeing the blank space before the claim.

kicker.hint: occasion or series name, 4 to 12 characters

title.hint: claim headline, 1 to 2 lines, up to 16 characters

subtitle.hint: one fact that supports the claim, set in the narrow column top right, up to 40 characters

subtitle.value: Last quarter six decks averaged four rounds; three of them touched only layout.
